issues.title: Set up GitHub: members, branch protection, project board
issues.body:
- [ ] Run `scripts/github_bootstrap.sh`
- [ ] Invite all 10 members, fill `scripts/members.json`, run `scripts/apply_members.py`
- [ ] Protect `main` and `develop`: 1 approval + CI
- [ ] Create a Projects board (Todo / In progress / Review / Done) and add all issues

issues.title: Walk the team through the contracts and freeze them
issues.body:
Contracts: `engine/types.py`, `cases.py`, `docs/API.md`, `web/static/css/tokens.css`.
- [ ] 30-min kickoff: architecture, ownership, workflow (CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Everyone runs `pytest -q` locally and opens a draft PR
- [ ] Freeze contracts at end of week 1

issues.title: Integration: make tests/test_integration.py pass on develop
issues.body:
- [ ] Chase blockers across rules / engine / API
- [ ] Merge develop → main, tag `v0.9`

issues.title: Final report, demo script and v1.0 release
issues.body:
- [ ] Collect report sections from every member
- [ ] 5-minute demo script (assignment sample → generated log → rules → tests → DFA)
- [ ] Fresh-clone check following README
- [ ] Tag `v1.0`

issues.title: Page 01 — Mask Logs
